description: Source code for a utility class 'TestWalker' that finds Android tests from the filesystem, supporting instrumentation and GTest framework tests, with methods for locating, parsing, and creating test suites based on Android.mk files and directory structure.

classes.name: TestWalker
classes.description: A class that finds Android tests from the filesystem, supporting various test types and directory structures.

methods.name: FindTests
methods.description: Main method to find tests at a given filesystem path, scanning subdirectories and upwards if necessary.

methods.name: _IsPathInBuildTree
methods.description: Checks if a given path is within the Android build directory.

methods.name: _MakePathRelativeToBuild
methods.description: Converts an absolute path to a path relative to the build root.

methods.name: _FindSubTests
methods.description: Recursively finds all tests within a directory, parsing Android.mk files.

methods.name: _FindUpstreamTests
methods.description: Searches upward in the directory hierarchy for test definitions.

methods.name: _GetTestFactory
methods.description: Returns a test factory for a given makefile path if valid.

methods.name: _GetTestFactoryForPath
methods.description: Gets the test factory for a specific filesystem path.

methods.name: _FindUpstreamTestFactory
methods.description: Recursively searches upward for a test factory.

methods.name: _CreateSuites
methods.description: Creates test suites from an AndroidMK parser and directory paths.
